changeSet.sql: update rel_transaction_candidate__tags set id = nextval('sequence_generator') where id is null

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: update transaction_candidate set category_source = 'MANUAL' where category_id is not null and classification_review_status = 'USER_SELECTED'
update transaction_candidate set category_source = 'AUTOMATIC' where category_id is not null and classification_review_status <> 'USER_SELECTED'
update rel_transaction_candidate__tags set source = 'MANUAL' where transaction_candidate_id in (select id from transaction_candidate where classification_review_status = 'USER_SELECTED')
update rel_transaction_candidate__tags set source = 'AUTOMATIC' where source is null
